items.title: Unit 3 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: The red hen is wet. Oh, no! My pet hen is in bed. We go to the vet. My hen has ten eggs!
items.why: In “My Pet Hen”, you hear: We go to the vet. The missing word is “vet”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 3, p.31 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
